description: The dataset records eight whale‑sighting observations with timestamps, latitude and longitude coordinates, species identification, certainty ratings, and identifiers. Date and time values are stored as text with second‑level resolution and serve as an aggregation key for temporal analysis. Latitude ranges from 0 to 78.66 degrees and longitude from 0 to 61.78 degrees, providing precise geospatial locations for mapping sightings. The Whale column lists five distinct species or unidentified groups, while Certainty indicates a definite or probable confidence level for each record. The integer Ind field (0‑10) functions as a primary key, and all rows share the same Event identifier for grouping. Researchers can use this data to examine the spatial and temporal distribution of whales and dolphins, evaluate observation confidence, and support marine‑biology tracking and conservation efforts.
